description: The abstain boundary the case defines explicitly: 'agentic AI means AI that can plan and carry out pre-approved steps across a workflow; people remain accountable for decisions that affect customers.' The GATE step in the pipeline checks every proposed action against this list before it is allowed to execute or reach a customer.

human_only_decision_categories.description: Any specific price, discount, or promotional offer quoted to a customer.
Any specific trade-in/exchange value quoted or implied for a customer's existing vehicle.
Any resolution, apology, or remedy offered for a service or product complaint — including auto-generated 'we're sorry' messages.
Any specific delivery date or commitment made to a customer.
Any loan/financing approval, EMI scheme confirmation, or credit-risk decision.
Any decision affecting dealer personnel or staffing levels.

hardship_boundary.description: Distinct from and stronger than the categories above. On any disclosed hardship signal, ALL automated customer-facing actions for that customer are suppressed, not just the ones that would have touched a human-only category.
hardship_boundary.required_response: single human-owned compassionate check-in, no sales/marketing/service content, refusal logged with rationale

what_the_agent_may_do_without_a_human_in: join/resolve identity records across systems (Resolve step)
classify a signal from existing evidence (Detect step)
assemble a context pack of relevant history and comparable resolutions for a human to use (Assemble step)
schedule or sequence a human follow-up within a defined timing window (Sequence step)

send low-risk, non-decisional, informational touches: service reminders, status updates, neutral reassurance content, document prep — never containing price, valuation, credit, or complaint-resolution content
log every action and every suppression, with a named human owner attached to any customer-facing next step
gate_rule: Before any action reaches a customer or is logged as taken, check: (1) is the signal hardship or customer_directed_pause? If yes -> suppress and route to human-only compassionate/respectful handling. (2) Does the proposed action fall in a human_only_decision_category? If yes -> reframe the action as a context pack for a human, never send it directly. (3) Otherwise -> the low-risk automated action may proceed, but must still be logged with a named human owner of record for that journey.
